newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILFIMA SAYS IN TALKS WITH WLMS DE BROE, SEMA.
newsitem.headline: VILFIMA SAYS IN TALKS WITH WLMS DE BROE, SEMA.

text.p: Lithuania's Vilfima, one of the country's leading brokerage houses, said on Thursday that its talks with Williams de Broe and spirits producer Sema over the distribution of Sema's share issue continued this week.

Sema said last month it was planning to sign an agreement with Williams de Broe and Vilfima to distribute a part of its new 18 million litas share issue, possibly in the form of gross depository receipts.
"I confirm that the talks between Vilfima, Williams de Broe and Sema have continued this week," Vilfima head Alvydas Zhabolis told Reuters.
Zhabolis declined to mention further details before the agreement was reached.
The current share capital of Sema is 20.7 million litas.
The state has a 27.16 percent stake in the company, which is on the Lithuanian stock exchange's A list.
Sema makes strong spirits used by other alcohol producers and exports around 50 percent of its products, mainly to CIS countries.
The company posted a 6.4 million litas net profit in 1996 and 397,000 litas for the first quarter of 1997.
